sloka: अथ पुत्रः पुलस्त्यस्य विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः ।अचिरेणैव कालेन पितेव तपसि स्थितः ।। ७.३.१ ॥
transliteration: atha putraḥ pulastyasya viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ ।acireṇaiva kālena piteva tapasi sthitaḥ ।। 7.3.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, Vishrava, the son of Pulastya and foremost among sages, soon became engaged in penance just like his father.
